description: Set Layer Options (Layers panel > Layer Options): rename, colour, show, lock, Print Layer, Suppress Text Wrap When Layer Is Hidden, Show Guides and Lock Guides

color.description: Layer colour: BLACK, BLUE, BRICK_RED, BROWN, BURGUNDY, CHARCOAL and the other UIColors names, or "#RRGGBB"

ignoreWrap.description: Suppress Text Wrap When Layer Is Hidden

lockGuides.description: Lock Guides that belong to the layer

printable.description: Print Layer: include the layer in print and PDF output

showGuides.description: Show Guides that belong to the layer

name: set_layer_options
title: Set Layer Options
